english: In heaven do rejoice the souls of the Saints who have followed the steps of Christ; and because they shed their blood for the love of Christ, therefore shall they be made glad for ever with Christ.
Peter the Apostle, and Paul the Teacher of the Gentiles, have taught us Thy law, O Lord.
These are they who while yet they lived in the flesh, planted the Church in their own blood; they drank of the Lord's cup, and became the friends of God.
They drank of the Lord's cup, and became the friends of God.
These men are saints, whom the Lord hath chosen in love unfeigned, and hath given them glory everlasting.
Because of the covenant of the Lord, and the laws of their fathers, the Saints of God abode in brotherly love, for one spirit and one faith was ever in them.
